Rules the app uses, and where they come from

HR zones as % of heart-rate reserve (Karvonen)zones, time in zoneResearch Karvonen 1957; Apple Watch default — to verify (research §E1)
Max HR fallback 220 − agesettingsResearch widely used, known to be imprecise — to verify (§E2)
Training load = TRIMP; fitness/fatigue = 42/7-day averagesdashboardResearch Banister impulse-response model — to verify (§E3)
Race prediction: Riegel, exponent 1.06dashboardResearch Riegel 1981 — to verify (§E4)
VO2max estimate (Daniels VDOT formula)dashboardResearch Daniels & Gilbert — to verify (§E5)
Grade-adjusted pace: +3.3 % per 1 % gradeactivity detailAssumption no source recorded — to verify (§E6)
